sanskrit: ahā rakṣitṛ tad imāṃ senāṃ rakṣatu | anuṣṭhātar anu tiṣṭha sarve vīrā bhavantu me ||
english: Day is the guardian — let it protect this army. O attendant, follow and stand firm; may all heroes be mine.
